title: kbotel.py drops a tool_result's duration, success flag and size because Claude Code sends them as strings
goal: kbotel.py serve keeps a tool_result's duration_ms, success and tool_result_size_bytes as Claude Code sends them, string-valued in OTLP-JSON (stringValue '716', 'true', '29'), as a non-negative number and a flag; the closed shapes stay closed: only a whole decimal string (digits, optionally one decimal point) counts as a number and only 'true' or 'false' as a flag, any other string is still dropped, and api_request's intValue and doubleValue attributes keep working; kb/_self/usage.md (OpenTelemetry events) says the string forms are read

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import kbotel; s = lambda k, v: {'key': k, 'value': {'stringValue': v}}; line = kbotel.event_of({'timeUnixNano': '1792705304038000000', 'attributes': [s('event.name', 'tool_result'), s('tool_name', 'Bash'), s('tool_use_id', 'toolu_011z5xT7aB9RQu1C7Z5tQgLZ'), s('success', 'true'), s('duration_ms', '716'), s('tool_result_size_bytes', '29')]}); sys.exit(0 if (line.get('duration_ms'), line.get('success'), line.get('tool_result_size_bytes')) == (716, True, 29) else 1)

import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import kbotel; s = lambda k, v: {'key': k, 'value': {'stringValue': v}}; ev = lambda *a: kbotel.event_of({'timeUnixNano': '1', 'attributes': [s('event.name', 'tool_result')] + list(a)}); good = ev(s('duration_ms', '7.5'), s('tool_result_size_bytes', '716'), s('success', 'false')); bad = ev(s('duration_ms', '12abc'), s('tool_result_size_bytes', '-5'), s('success', 'yes')); sys.exit(0 if (good.get('duration_ms'), good.get('tool_result_size_bytes'), good.get('success')) == (7.5, 716, False) and not any(k in bad for k in ('duration_ms', 'tool_result_size_bytes', 'success')) else 1)

import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import kbotel; a = lambda k, t, v: {'key': k, 'value': {t: v}}; api = kbotel.event_of({'timeUnixNano': '1', 'attributes': [a('event.name', 'stringValue', 'api_request'), a('duration_ms', 'intValue', '1819'), a('cost_usd', 'doubleValue', 0.0032), a('input_tokens', 'stringValue', '2')]}); sys.exit(0 if (api.get('duration_ms'), api.get('cost_usd'), api.get('input_tokens')) == (1819, 0.0032, 2) else 1)

import subprocess, sys; r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/selfdoc.py', 'section', 'usage', 'OpenTelemetry events'], capture_output=True, text=True); sys.exit(0 if r.returncode == 0 and 'stringValue' in r.stdout else 1)

the closed shapes stay closed: only a whole decimal string (digits, optionally one decimal point) counts as a number and only 'true' or 'false' as a flag, any other string is still dropped
api_request's intValue and doubleValue attributes keep working
kb/_self/usage.md (OpenTelemetry events) says the string forms are read

gates.question: How does kbotel.kept read a string-valued number or flag: which strings count? Recommended: ASCII digits with at most one inner decimal point, bounded length; only true/false as flags; id and name shapes untouched
options: any string int() or float() parses

notes: Found 2026-10-22: a claude -p --model haiku session (Claude Code telemetry on, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_LOGS_PROTOCOL=http/json) sent tool_result attributes as {"success": {"stringValue": "true"}, "duration_ms": {"stringValue": "716"}, "tool_result_size_bytes": {"stringValue": "29"}} while api_request sent intValue/doubleValue; kbotel.kept() (number and flag shapes) accepts only int/float/bool, so every tool_result line lacks the three fields although EVENT_KEYS allows them and usage.md promises tool results' durations. kbotel join is unaffected (it counts tool_result events, it reads no duration).
